title: Sr. Systems Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**WHO WE ARE**
Come join our Technology Team and start reimagining the future of the automotive aftermarket. We are a highly motivated tech-focused organization, excited to be amid dynamic innovation and transformational change. Driven by Advance’s top-down commitment to empowering our team members, we are focused on delighting our Customers with Care and Speed, through delivery of world class technology solutions and products.
  
  
We value and cultivate our culture by seeking to always be collaborative, intellectually curious, fun, open, and diverse. You will be a key member of a growing and passionate group focused on collaborating across business and technology resources to drive forward key programs and projects building enterprise capabilities across Advance Auto Parts.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Join the AAP team and start reimagining the future of automotive retail. Disrupt the way consumers buy auto parts and take on the industry’s biggest challengers to execute on AAP's top-down commitment to digital expansion.
  
  
As a member of the Advance Auto Parts team, you will have an opportunity to disrupt a $150B auto parts industry to bring better and faster solutions to customers. You will be part of a team helping the company live its mission of “Advancing a World in Motion”. The role is part of a merit-based organization with a culture of professional growth and development, and emphasis on the latest tools, platforms and technologies.
  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Unix Administration & Backup/Storage Platform Engineer to lead and manage enterprise Unix/Linux, Backup, Storage, and Recovery platforms across on-premises and cloud environments. This role will serve as a technical leader responsible for platform stability, automation, recovery readiness, storage operations, and infrastructure resiliency across hybrid cloud environments.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Unix/Linux Administration, Commvault, NetApp, IBM Storage, Nutanix, and cloud-native backup and recovery solutions in Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Unix / Linux Administration (Primary Focus)

+ Own and manage enterprise Unix/Linux infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments.
+ Administer, configure, harden, patch, upgrade, and troubleshoot Linux platforms.
+ Lead OS lifecycle management, security compliance, vulnerability remediation, and performance tuning activities.
+ Develop and maintain standard OS builds, automation, and configuration management processes.
+ Support application onboarding, middleware integration, and infrastructure services running on Linux platforms.
+ Troubleshoot complex operating system, performance, networking, storage, and application-related issues.
+ Drive automation using Shell scripting, Python, Ansible, or similar tools.
+ Partner with Security, Application, Cloud, and Infrastructure teams to ensure platform resiliency and operational excellence.

* Backup & Storage Administration

+ Own and manage enterprise Backup & Storage platforms across on-premises and cloud environments.
+ Serve as the primary SME for backup, recovery, replication, storage, and disaster recovery technologies.
+ Design, implement, administer, and support backup, recovery, storage, replication, and business continuity solutions.
+ Manage and support Commvault Backup & Recovery, including administration, configuration, upgrades, patching, troubleshooting, optimization, and recovery operations.
+ Administer enterprise storage platforms including NetApp and IBM Storage.
+ Support and manage Nutanix infrastructure and virtualization platforms.
+ Implement and optimize Azure Native Backup and GCP Backup & Recovery solutions.
+ Define and manage backup policies, retention policies, storage lifecycle management, governance, compliance, and disaster recovery standards.
+ Perform storage architecture reviews, capacity planning, performance analysis, optimization, and technology refresh initiatives.
+ Lead backup restore testing, disaster recovery exercises, and business continuity validation activities.
+ Support backup and recovery operations for enterprise databases including Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, DB2, and MongoDB.
+ Troubleshoot complex backup, storage, replication, and recovery issues across hybrid cloud environments.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in Unix/Linux Administration, Storage, Backup, and Infrastructure Operations.
* Strong hands-on Linux administration experience in enterprise environments.
* Experience managing Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Unix/Linux platforms, patching, upgrades, troubleshooting, and automation.
* Strong expertise with Commvault Backup & Recovery.
* Experience administering NetApp and IBM Storage platforms.
* Experience supporting Nutanix infrastructure and virtualization environments.
* Hands-on experience with Azure Backup and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Backup & Recovery services.
* Strong understanding of storage technologies, backup strategies, retention management, replication, deduplication, ransomware protection, and disaster recovery.
* Experience supporting enterprise databases including Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, DB2, and MongoDB.
* Experience with capacity planning, performance tuning, infrastructure operations, and platform lifecycle management.
* Strong troubleshooting, incident management, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to lead cross-functional technical initiatives and major incident resolution efforts.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with automation tools such as Ansible, Terraform, Shell Scripting, Python, or PowerShell.
* Experience supporting hybrid cloud environments across Azure and GCP.
* Cloud certifications in Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
* Commvault, NetApp, Nutanix, Linux, or Storage-related certifications.
* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise infrastructure platforms.

title: Associate Test Systems Engineer – Controls
description:
**Job Description Summary**
GE Vernova is seeking a motivated and technically curious Associate Test Systems Engineer to join our Controls Test Engineering team in Hyderabad. In this role, you will play a vital part in ensuring the reliability and performance of advanced power generation systems, including turbine controls, Distributed Control Systems (DCS), and excitation technologies.
  
  
This position is designed for an early-career engineer who is eager to bridge the gap between academic theory and high-stakes industrial applications. Working alongside senior engineering experts, you will gain hands-on experience in the full lifecycle of automated test systems, from design and validation troubleshooting and continuous process improvement.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Test System Design & Validation: Support the development and validation of Automated Test Equipment (ATE) to ensure high-quality product output.
* Technical Troubleshooting: Perform root-cause analysis on electrical test failures, identifying and implementing practical, long-term solutions.
* Operational Excellence: Maintain and improve test fixtures, tools, and hardware/software platforms. Ensure all equipment remains calibrated, operational, and compliant with safety standards.
* Documentation & Configuration: Manage Bills of Materials (BOMs), maintain source code, and keep detailed records of configurations and test procedures.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with global teams in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain to drive efficiency and support production goals.
* Continuous Improvement: Participate in hardware and software upgrades, proactively identifying opportunities to optimize test processes.

* Agility: A proactive learner who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Flexibility: Willingness to travel domestically or internationally for project support as required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to industrial software tools (e.g., LabVIEW, TestStand).
* Demonstrated project or internship experience involving C and C++ Programming.
* Passion for energy and industrial automation.

title: Infrastructure Systems Engineer III
description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments - creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, administer, upgrade, and maintain IBM WebSphere Application Server (WAS) environments.
* Manage WebSphere profiles, nodes, deployment managers, clusters, JVMs, virtual hosts, JDBC providers, data sources, connection pools, and shared libraries.
* Perform application deployments, configuration changes, JVM restarts, cluster operations, and production releases.
* Configure and support IBM WebSphere Portal Server, including portal clusters, application deployments, configuration, security integration, and troubleshooting.
* Administer and support IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW) environments.
* Support BAW application deployments, process applications, workflow services, environment configuration, and production issues.
* Configure SSL/TLS certificates, HTTPS, virtual hosts, routing, load balancing, and WebSphere plug-in configurations.
* Troubleshoot WebSphere, Portal, and BAW connectivity and application issues.
* Integrate middleware platforms with enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions.
* Manage SSL certificates, keystores, truststores, certificate renewals, and secure communication between middleware components.
* Create and maintain Jenkins CI/CD pipelines for middleware deployments and operational automation.
* Automate application deployments, configuration changes, server restarts, and routine administrative activities using Jenkins and scripting.
* Develop and maintain Shell, Python, Jython/Wsadmin, or PowerShell scripts for middleware automation.
* Perform middleware patching, fix-pack installation, version upgrades, vulnerability remediation, and security hardening.
* Monitor JVM health, heap utilization, thread pools, JDBC connection pools, CPU, memory, application response times, and system performance.
* Analyze logs, JVM dumps, heap dumps, thread dumps, SystemOut/SystemErr logs, and application logs.
* Troubleshoot production incidents involving application availability, JVM hangs, OutOfMemory conditions, high CPU, connection issues, SSL errors, and deployment failures.
* Perform performance tuning and capacity planning for middleware environments.
* Configure high availability, clustering, failover, session persistence, and load balancing.
* Maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, installation procedures, operational runbooks, and troubleshooting guides.
* Coordinate with application development, infrastructure, database, security, networking, DevOps, and production support teams.
* Participate in production releases, change management, incident management, problem management, and root-cause analysis.
* Provide on-call and production support for critical enterprise middleware applications.
* Be willing to work after hours to support production maintenance windows.

**Required Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience with IBM WebSphere Application Server.
* Experience with IBM WebSphere Portal Server.
* Experience administering IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW).
* Strong knowledge of IBM HTTP Server (IHS) Experience with IAM, LDAP, Active Directory, SSO, authentication, and authorization.
* Experience building and maintaining Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong understanding of WebSphere clustering and high-availability architecture.
* Experience with SSL/TLS, certificates, keystores, and truststores.
* Experience with application deployment and middleware configuration.
* Experience with WebSphere wsadmin and Jython scripting Shell/Unix/Linux scripting knowledge.
* Strong Linux/Unix administration skills Knowledge of JVM configuration, garbage collection, heap analysis, and performance tuning.
* Experience troubleshooting enterprise production environments.
* Knowledge of HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, DNS, load balancers, firewalls, and networking concepts.
* Experience with middleware patching, upgrades, vulnerability remediation, and security hardening.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes including incident, change, and problem management.

**Preferred Skills**

* IBM WebSphere Application Server 8.5/9.x
* IBM Business Automation Workflow 20.x/21.x/23.x/24.x
* IBM WebSphere Portal / HCL Digital Experience
* Experience IBM HTTP Server 8.5/9.x
* Integration with IBM IAM and IBM TIM
* WebSphere Liberty experience
* Git/GitHub/Bitbucket experience
* Ansible or other infrastructure automation tools
* Splunk or similar monitoring/log-analysis tools like Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or other APM tools
* AWS or Azure cloud experience
* Containerization experience with Docker/Kubernetes/OpenShift
* DevOps and CI/CD implementation experience

**Experience**

* 10 yrs of Middleware Administration/Engineering experience preferred
* 5+ yrs of hands-on IBM WebSphere Application Server administration
* 5+ yrs of hands-on IBM WebSphere Portal Server administration.
* 5+ yrs of hands-on IBM WebSphere Process Server Or IBM BAW
* 3 yrs of hands-on integration with IBM IAM, IBM TIM and LDAP
* Strong production support experience in large-scale, highly available enterprise environments.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

title: Systems Engineer- Workday - Finance ERP
description:
**Description**
**Job Details & Key Responsibilities**
Systems Engineer is responsible for administering and managing the Finance systems & applications that support our mission critical business processes. Systems Engineer will be the primary process expert in their service area and will work in collaboration with developers, business stakeholders, and other technology teams in support of Salesforce end to end business processes. Daily activities will include, but are not limited to, enterprise application support, resolving technical and functional system issues, performing trend analysis and identifying enhancements to reduce support requests, and collaborating with development teams to implement new and enhanced functionality. The successful candidate must be agile and able to support multiple priorities.
  
  
**Required Skills**

* 4-9 years of Hands-on expertise in any of the Workday Financials modules (Account Receivables, Payables, Assets, GL, Banking & Settlement).
* Working knowledge of Workday Security, Business Processes, Reports, Calc Fields, Integrations framework, Studio, BIRT and EIBs.
* Expertise in Workday Fundamentals and Financial Functional Configurations.
* Expertise in handling production support cases (L2/L3), incident management and problem management.
* Certified Workday expert in at-least one of the Financial module.
* Experience in Accounting Center and Prism Analytics for finance data transformation and reporting.
* Well-versed with Workday Community and latest features/enhancements of Workday Releases.
* Analyze and resolve complex configuration, automation, data, security, and integration issues.
* Perform root-cause analysis and implement preventive solutions rather than relying on workarounds.
* Experience working in a SOX compliant environment.
* Demonstrate experience through AI/agentic workflow transformation, including redesigning processes to incorporate AI agents alongside human support engineers.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual business processes and improve operational efficiency.

**Desired Skills/Experience**

* Experience in global ERP implementation especially implementations related to North America , EMEA, APAC countries
* Experience working as part of a Scrum team practicing Agile development methodologies.
* Knowledge of accounting principles and financial cloud applications.
* Knowledge of Salesforce platform or Mulesoft Cloud hub is a huge plus.
* Knowledge of Coupa, Concur or other Financials SaaS applications will be an added advantage.
